title: Opinion Dynamics-based Coalition Formation for Federated Learning in Heterogeneous IoT Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.19695v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated learning (FL) enables privacy-preserving, on-device training across heterogeneous Internet-of-Things (IoT) deployments such as smart-city water-metering networks, where each smart meter observes a household-specific consumption time series. Under such statistical heterogeneity, the standard Federated Averaging (FedAvg) aggregation averages dissimilar local models into a single global model that may fail to capture client-specific patterns. We address this by forming client coalitions directly in the local-weight space and aggregating at the coalition level. Extending a prior weight-driven coalition-formation scheme, we model coalition formation as a Hegselmann-Krause (HK) bounded-confidence opinion-dynamics process acting on the local weights, and develop variants of the HK interaction based on Euclidean-distance and cosine-similarity confidence criteria. translated_title: 异构物联网系统中基于观点动力学的联邦学习联盟形成
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）能够在异构物联网部署中实现隐私保护的设备端训练，例如智慧城市水表计量网络，其中每个智能水表观测一个家庭特定的用水时间序列。在这种统计异质性下，标准的联邦平均方法将不相似的本地模型平均为单一全局模型，可能无法捕获客户端特定的模式。我们通过直接在本地权重空间中形成客户端联盟并在联盟层面进行聚合来解决这一问题。在扩展先前基于权重的联盟形成方案的基础上，我们将联盟形成建模为作用于本地权重的Hegselmann-Krause（HK）有界置信观点动力学过程，并开发了基于欧氏距离和余弦相似度置信准则的HK交互变体。该框架被应用于短期用水量预测。
tldr: 该论文将联邦学习中的客户端联盟形成建模为Hegselmann-Krause有界置信观点动力学过程，通过在本地权重空间中基于欧氏距离和余弦相似度置信准则形成联盟并在联盟层面聚合，解决了异构物联网系统中统计异质性导致FedAvg无法捕获客户端特定模式的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper models client coalition formation in federated learning as a Hegselmann-Krause bounded-confidence opinion-dynamics process, forming coalitions in the local-weight space based on Euclidean-distance and cosine-similarity confidence criteria and aggregating at the coalition level to address the problem that FedAvg fails to capture client-specific patterns under statistical heterogeneity in heterogeneous IoT systems.
